QuestInfo.name: Finally Friends
QuestInfo.0: It's time for you to do some serious introspection.
QuestInfo.1: After all that soul-searching, you decide that maybe Irena's not so bad. Maybe you CAN be friends with her. Go talk to her.
QuestInfo.2: After all that soul-searching, you decide that maybe Irena's not so bad. Turns out, she doesn't think you're so bad, either. Guess the two of you can be friends.

0.0: I've been too caught up trying to beat Irena to see the world around me. I only thought about beating her, but now I think I understand. It's okay to rely on people with great strength. Those are the people you can trust when times go bad. That's what you were missing, wasn't it father?
0.1: I should speak with Irena. She would make a powerful ally.\r\n\r\n#b(You will be moved directly to the Six Path Crossway if you accept.)#k

no.0: It's going to be really awkward. Maybe I should get something to eat and think about it...

1.0: Hey, buddy! I heard about what you did in the swamp. Don't worry about that dressing-down you got from Neinheart. He was probably just cranky. \r\n#L0##bIrena, I need to be straight with you. I've been jealous of you. I saw your accomplishments and your skills as a threat to me. It wasn't fair, and I want to apologize. Can you forgive me?#l\n#k
1.1: YOU were jealous of ME? Hahahaha! That's ridiculous! From the moment I set eyes on you, I though to myself 'now THIS is natural-born talent.' I've been doing everything I can just to keep up with you. I'm flattered that you would even have those thoughts for a split second.

yes.0: Friends, okay? To the very end.
